subject: Conditional prepayment + PO identifier reconciliation for Lumina
content:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@luminasys.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@luminasys.com
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2024 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood contract question — prepayment + PO fields

Hi Karthik,

Following our pilot call today, procurement asked for two clarifications before issuing the PO:

1) Lumina requires a 30% prepayment for new integrations; can Redwood accept a split invoice (30% upfront, 70% monthly) and issue an initial invoice immediately upon PO acceptance?
2) Our ERP requires a strict PO identifier format (PO-<entity>-<yyyy><mm><dd>-<seq>). Can Redwood put the full PO string on every invoice line and in the invoice header?

We'd like to get this locked before we route to finance — otherwise they will push Net-60 and we won't be able to finalize the calendar.

Please see the attached PO template we use internally.

Best,
Olivia Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Lumina Systems

Attachments: PO_Template_Lumina.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@luminasys.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood contract question — prepayment + PO fields

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear note and the template. Short answers up front: yes on the PO identifier in header/lines; conditional yes on the 30% prepayment (we'll need a short exception and timing detail).

Couple of practical questions so our billing/legal teams can prepare the invoice:
- Is the 30% prepayment refundable if the initial integration fails to meet the acceptance criteria? If so, what acceptance window are you comfortable with (30/45/60 days)?
- Do you want the 30% to be invoiced to the PO immediately after ECA (executed contract acceptance) or on shipment/first delivery milestone?
- Please confirm exact PO example we should mirror (e.g., PO-LUMINA-20240424-001).

I've looped in Vanessa (customer success/account ops) to propose an execution plan and Ben from billing to comment on invoice metadata.

Thanks —
Karthik
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@luminasys.com>, procurement@luminasys.com
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2024 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood contract question — prepayment + PO fields

All,

Billing notes: we can accept the PO identifier on every invoice line and in the header — our invoice generator supports a custom PO field up to 80 chars. For the 30% prepayment: we can create an initial invoice for 30% marked as "Prepayment — non-refundable / refundable per SOW" depending on the SOW language. Two constraints to be aware of:

1) If Lumina requires refundability tied to acceptance, we need the acceptance criteria captured in the SOW and a clear timebox (we recommend 30 days post-delivery for integrations).
2) Our standard hosted-customer billing cadence is monthly on the 1st; prepayments can be invoiced immediately but the customer must send a PO referencing the invoice date. For collections, Redwood requires net terms be agreed in writing; if procurement proceeds with Net-60, senior finance will require an offset/credit holdback.

Suggested compromise: issue 30% prepayment invoice immediately on PO acceptance; hold 10% as an acceptance holdback refundable at day 30 if acceptance criteria are met — remaining 60% invoiced monthly over next 3 months. This reduces Lumina's risk and avoids Net-60 on the full amount.

I'll attach a sample SOW excerpt showing acceptance clause we use.

– Ben
Senior Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW excerpt, 45KB)

---

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@luminasys.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 26 Apr 2024 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood contract question — prepayment + PO fields

Hi Olivia — appreciate the template. Operationally, here's a proposed workflow that kept other customers moving: 

1) Lumina issues PO with your PO format and indicates "30% prepay / 70% post-delivery" in PO notes.
2) Redwood issues Invoice #1 for 30% upon PO receipt (invoice header includes PO string).
3) Redwood ships first delivery / completes baseline integration milestone. Lumina validates against acceptance checklist within 30 days.
4) If acceptance is OK, Redwood refunds 10% holdback (applied as credit) and invoices the remaining balance monthly (split across 3 invoices).

This satisfies procurement wanting prepay and our need to avoid Net-60 on the full contract. Can Lumina confirm they can accept a 30% upfront with a 10% holdback? If not, what's the minimum holdback you need?

We can turn this into an addendum to the SOW and push to DocuSign once agreed.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

---

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@luminasys.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2024 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood contract question — prepayment + PO fields

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Lumina can accept the 30% prepayment with a 10% holdback (i.e., 30% invoiced, 10% held refundable on acceptance at day 30). Acceptance window of 30 days is fine.

Couple of items for Redwood to confirm before we issue the PO tomorrow: 
- Please ensure every invoice line and the invoice header includes the full PO: PO-LUMINA-20240429-002.
- Please mark Invoice #1 as "Prepayment — non-recurring" in the description so our ERP posts correctly.
- Can you confirm the credit note flow (if holdback refunded) — will Redwood issue a credit memo referencing the original invoice number?

If you can confirm those three points I will route to finance with the PO template and we will issue PO-LUMINA-20240429-002.

Best,
Olivia

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@luminasys.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Apr 2024 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood contract question — prepayment + PO fields

Great — thanks Olivia. Confirming the three points from Redwood: 
1) We will include the full PO string on the invoice header and every invoice line exactly as provided.
2) Invoice #1 description will read: "Prepayment — non-recurring (30% of contract value)" to align with Lumina ERP posting.
3) If the 10% holdback is refunded, Redwood will issue a credit memo referencing the original Invoice #1 and the PO; credit memo will post within 5 business days of confirmed acceptance and be visible in the next billing cycle.

I've attached the final SOW excerpt and a clean PO example for your legal/operations team. Once you confirm issuance of PO-LUMINA-20240429-002, we'll generate Invoice #1 and send DocuSign for the SOW addendum.

Next steps: Olivia to issue PO; Redwood to send Invoice #1 and DocuSign link.

Thanks all —
Karthik
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf, PO_Template_Lumina.xlsx
